visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of dark bordered cards with an icon, title and description, each linking to an item

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: icon cell (image, :icon: or emoji) | body cell (title, usually linked, then description). The first link in the row becomes the link for the whole card

usage: Arcade index: one card per game with emoji icon, title, description and link.
reuseGuidance: Use for linked icon cards on dark sections. Use cards-teaser for image teasers with dates.
